title: Martyrologium Romanum Gregorii XIII. Pont. Max. iussu editum, et Urbani VIII. auctoritate recognitum. Accesserunt notationes atque tractatio de Martyrologio Romano, auctore Caesare Baronio Sorano
note: Transcribed from the public-domain scan (Internet Archive bub_gb_2pQUlbrbtAsC) into TEI and proofread against the page images in two passes; long s normalized to s, everything else (u/v, i/j, æ/œ, accents, abbreviation tildes, the printer's misprints) as printed. Baronius's reference letters are removed from the eulogies; his Notationes are not yet included. The closing formula is printed once, on 1 January ('Sic semper terminatur lectio Martyrologij'), and is given here for every day.
